tag: 男女在窗邊餐桌前吃沙拉

level.why: 兩人動作不同（一人舉叉進食、一人握叉轉頭交談），並含人數與桌上物品位置等細節。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of two friends eating lunch at a restaurant table. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: Two or three people clearly interacting with each other or with objects, with clear positional relationships (at, on, beside, in front of, next to). No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: A woman and a man are sitting across from each other at a wooden table by a window.
The woman is lifting a fork with some food toward her mouth and laughing.
The man is holding a fork and smiling at the woman.
A salad is in front of each person, and a black menu folder lies in front of them.
Two water glasses, salt and pepper shakers and napkins with cutlery are on the table.

pool.t: Two people are having a meal at a wooden table.
pool.zh: 兩個人正在一張木桌前用餐。
pool.why: 正解：一男一女坐在木桌前，桌上有餐點，正在用餐，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The woman is lifting a fork toward her mouth.
pool.zh: 這名女子正把叉子舉向嘴邊。
pool.why: 正解：女子手持叉子，叉著食物送往嘴邊，與畫面相符。

pool.t: There is a salad in front of each person.
pool.zh: 每個人面前都有一份沙拉。
pool.why: 正解：男子與女子面前的盤子裡都有沙拉，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The two people are setting the table together.
pool.zh: 這兩個人正一起擺設餐桌。
pool.why: setting 與 sitting 音近；畫面中兩人是坐著用餐，沒有在擺桌。

pool.t: A waiter is bringing more salad to the table.
pool.zh: 一名服務生正把更多沙拉端到桌上。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有服務生在上菜，桌邊只有這兩個人。

pool.t: A candle is burning in the middle of the table.
pool.zh: 桌子中央點著一根蠟燭。
pool.why: 桌上沒有蠟燭，只有餐盤、水杯、調味罐、餐巾與菜單夾。

pool.t: The man is reading a menu at the table.
pool.zh: 這名男子正在桌邊看菜單。
pool.why: 菜單夾是闔上放在桌面，男子手持叉子，沒有在看菜單。

pool.t: The woman is handing a fork to the man.
pool.zh: 這名女子正把叉子遞給男子。
pool.why: handing 與 holding 是近義動作干擾；兩人各自拿著自己的叉子，沒有互相遞交。

pool.t: Both people are talking on the phone.
pool.why: 畫面中沒有人拿手機，兩人是面對面交談並用餐。

pool.t: Three people are sharing a table by the window.
pool.zh: 三個人共用窗邊的一張桌子。
pool.why: 這張桌前只有兩個人，不是三個人。

pool.t: The napkins are folded on top of the plates.
pool.zh: 餐巾被折好放在盤子上面。
pool.why: 餐巾放在桌面上，旁邊有刀叉，沒有放在盤子上。

pool.t: They are discussing a business deal over lunch.
pool.zh: 他們正一邊吃午餐一邊討論一筆生意。
pool.why: 畫面只看得出兩人用餐聊天，無法確認談話內容是生意，這是過度推論。

vocab.col: a fork and knife / hold a fork
green salad / a bowl of salad

issues: 圖片內容與 image_prompt 相符：兩人在餐廳窗邊餐桌用餐；實際為一男一女。
畫面右側背景邊緣有一個模糊的人影，不屬於主體；文本已避免以「只有兩個人在餐廳內」作為絕對說法，錯誤句只針對這張桌子的人數。
桌上的黑色物件推測為菜單夾，封面無可讀文字；正解句未直接使用菜單，僅在錯誤句中出現。
圖中無可讀文字或商標；手部與叉子畫面自然，未見明顯瑕疵。
